description: This file implements the TraceUnit class and its nested TraceBuffer class, providing tracing and logging functionalities including buffer management, category control, and data output for the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: TraceUnit
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing trace categories, buffers, and output channels within the WPEFramework project.

methods.name: TraceBuffer
methods.description: Nested class managing cyclic buffer for trace data, including buffer overwriting and data availability signaling.

methods.name: TraceUnit::TraceBuffer::GetOverwriteSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of data to overwrite in the buffer by flushing existing data.

methods.name: TraceUnit::TraceBuffer::DataAvailable
methods.description: Signals that new data is available in the buffer by ringing the doorbell.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TraceUnit.

methods.name: TraceUnit::~TraceUnit
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up categories and output channel.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Open
methods.description: Opens a trace buffer with a specific identifier or path, setting environment variables accordingly.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Close
methods.description: Closes the current output channel and cleans up resources.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Announce
methods.description: Adds a trace category to the list of categories managed by TraceUnit.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Revoke
methods.description: Removes a trace category from the list.

methods.name: TraceUnit::GetCategories
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the current trace categories.

methods.name: TraceUnit::SetCategories
methods.description: Enables or disables categories based on module and category names.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Defaults
methods.description: Returns the default trace categories as a JSON string.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Defaults(const string&)
methods.description: Sets default categories from a JSON string.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Defaults(Core::File&)
methods.description: Sets default categories from a file.

methods.name: TraceUnit::UpdateEnabledCategories
methods.description: Updates the enabled/disabled state of categories based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: TraceUnit::IsDefaultCategory
methods.description: Checks if a given module and category are default categories and returns their enabled state.

methods.name: TraceUnit::Trace
methods.description: Logs a trace message with contextual information such as file, line, class, and category.
